scientific_integrity: The infinite conclusion follows from a direct multiplicative proof; the packaged finite experiment is only corroboration. Independent validation and audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to Omega(n)<=4 and does not decide the global infinitude question. The equality cases 20 and 45 and the two-prime factor calculations are known; novelty is assessed for the complete multiplicity cutoff and the p-squared-times-two-distinct-primes exclusion. An equivalent unindexed theorem remains a priority risk.
title: The first four prime-factor layers of unitary–exponential divisor-sum equality
